198: @commands.before_write.register(Context, Model, PostgreSQL)
199: def before_write(
200:     context: Context,
201:     model: Model,
202:     backend: PostgreSQL,
203:     *,
204:     data: DataSubItem,
205: ) -> dict:
206:     patch = take(['_id'], data.patch)
207:     patch['_revision'] = take('_revision', data.patch, data.saved)
208:     patch['_txn'] = context.get('transaction').id
209:     patch['_created'] = utcnow()
210:     for prop in take(model.properties).values():
211:         if isinstance(prop.dtype, Denorm):
212:             prop_data = data[prop.name.split('.')[0]]
213:         else:
214:             prop_data = data[prop.name]
215:         value = commands.before_write(
216:             context,
217:             prop.dtype,
218:             backend,
219:             data=prop_data,
220:         )
221:         patch.update(value)
222:     return patch
